cases.title: One pair in focus (Bar's Trim Paths End): no demonstration, a walkthrough in words

rubric.reason: In turn 3 the mentor says "if I shaped it there'd be nothing left for you to do. I'll talk you through it instead" and walks through it in words (handles on End's keys, lengthen the 1.2 s landing handle sideways along the bottom, shorten the 0.2 s start handle), with the speed graph opened in turn 2 and no influence or speed numbers.

Every name and time comes from the snapshots or the record: Title (eased_layers), its Position and Scale pairs (4.37 s rounds 4.367), Old Take, CTRL, Icon, Logo's Rotation, Subtitle's Opacity, Bar's X Position, Glow's Blurriness, and Bar's End under Trim Paths 1 at 0.2 to 1.2 s.

Each turn is short and ends with something to do: turn 1 gives the proposal, the leave-outs one per kind and the land-hard question; turn 2 asks the reading question; turn 3 declines the demo and gives the influence idea plus one task ending "Do that on Bar's End and say done"; turn 4 confirms the goal in one sentence and gives the task again.

In turn 3 the mentor says a demo would leave nothing for the learner and promises "I'll talk you through it instead", but only explains reading the curve ("the higher the curve, the faster End is changing"); it never walks through selecting the keys, lengthening the landing handle sideways along the bottom, or shortening the start handle.

Every name and time matches the tool results: Title's Position 0.5–1.5, 1.5–3 and 3–4.37 s (4.367 rounded), Scale 0.5–1.5 s, Old Take, CTRL, Icon, Logo's Rotation, Subtitle's Opacity, Bar's X Position, Glow's Blurriness, and Bar's End 0.2–1.2 s; "the layer you eased before" follows from eased_layers ["Title"].

Each turn is short and moves one idea: turn 2 sets the pair and asks the reading question, turn 3 answers the demo request in two sentences and restates the pending reading question, and turn 4 acknowledges the soft-arrival goal and asks the reading question again; each ends with something for the learner to answer.

With Bar's End as the only pair, the mentor gave no demo and said why ('if I shaped it, there'd be nothing left for you to do'), and walked through selecting End, opening the Graph Editor and choosing Edit Speed Graph in words with no numbers; the transcript ends at the reading question, before the handle-shaping step is due.

Every name and time matches the tool results: Title's Position 0.5–1.5, 1.5–3 and 3–4.37 s, its Scale, Old Take, CTRL, Icon, Logo's Rotation, Subtitle/Bar/Glow ease-first properties, and Bar's End 0.2–1.2 s with its display path; 'the only eased move on Bar' follows from X Position being listed as ease-first.

Each turn moves one idea and ends on a question: turn 1 gives the proposal and the leave-outs, then asks about landing hard; turn 2 gives the reading steps and asks where it's fastest; turns 3 and 4 answer the side remark in a sentence or two, then restate the pending reading question.
